have hpair (A : Set S) : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    by_contra h
    have hA : A ∉ P := fun hA => h (Or.inl hA)
    have hAc : Aᶜ ∉ P := fun hAc => h (Or.inr hAc)
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hmiss A hA
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hAcV⟩ := hmiss Aᶜ hAc
    have hUV : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
      by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
      · have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
        rw [hAU] at hx
        simpa using hx
      · have hxAc : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simpa using hxA
        have hx : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hxAc, hxV⟩
        rw [hAcV] at hx
        simpa using hx
    exact (hPP U hU V hV) hUV

have hpair (A : Set S) : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    by_contra h
    have hA : A ∉ P := fun hA => h (Or.inl hA)
    have hAc : Aᶜ ∉ P := fun hAc => h (Or.inr hAc)
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hmiss A hA
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hAcV⟩ := hmiss Aᶜ hAc
    have hUV : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
      by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
      · have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
        rw [hAU] at hx
        simpa using hx
      · have hxAc : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simpa using hxA
        have hx : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hxAc, hxV⟩
        rw [hAcV] at hx
        simpa using hx
    exact (hPP U hU V hV) hUV

      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
      by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
      · have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩

        simpa using hx
      · have hxAc : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simpa using hxA
        have hx : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hxAc, hxV⟩
        rw [hAcV] at hx
        simpa using hx
